node.title: Re: Peculiar hash behavior
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: What you are seeing is the effect of [doc://perldata#Multi-dimensional-array-emulation] combined with the pitfalls of [doc://Data::Dumper]'s default settings that [jwkrahn] [id://11137192|pointed out]. You may also be interested in [mod://Data::Dump] or my emulation of it [id://1228300|here].
